name: Makita XCU08 / XCU09
blurb: 36 V cordless saws. XCU08 ships with 14″, XCU09 with 16″. The manual approves 10″–16″ in 90PX (.043″, 40/46/52/56 drive links) or 91PX (.050″, the same counts).
intro: Makita's XCU08 and XCU09 share one manual and one chain table. The manual's standard bar is 14″ on the XCU08 and 16″ on the XCU09, and the approved bars run 10″, 12″, 14″ and 16″ in two chain types: 90PX at 1.1 mm (.043″) and 91PX at 1.3 mm (.050″). Drive links are 40, 46, 52 and 56 for those four lengths, the same counts in both gauges. The bar part numbers are not the same. Makita prints the pitch as 3/8″; Echo's chain chart, which defines the 90PX and 91PX codes, classes both as 3/8″ low profile. Makita prints the 90PX file as 4.5 mm (3/16″). 4.5 mm is 11/64″, so that is the file size on the 90PX rows. The 91PX file is 4.0 mm (5/32″).

bars.label: 10″ (90PX)
bars.note: Makita's XCU08/XCU09 manual: chain type 90PX, 40 drive links, bar part 161846-0, 3/8″ pitch, gauge 1.1 mm (0.043″), sprocket-nose bar. Echo's chart classes 90PX as 3/8″ low profile. Makita prints the 90PX round file as 4.5 mm (3/16″). 4.5 mm is 11/64″, which is the file size stored here.
